input.query: WITH m AS (SELECT signup_month, sum(n_activated)::DOUBLE/sum(n_signups) rate FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month < '2026-05-01' GROUP BY 1), d AS (SELECT *, rate-lag(rate) OVER (ORDER BY signup_month) delta FROM m) SELECT avg(rate) FILTER(WHERE signup_month<'2026-03-01') historical_mean, stddev_samp(rate) FILTER(WHERE signup_month<'2026-03-01') historical_monthly_sd, stddev_samp(delta) FILTER(WHERE signup_month<'2026-03-01') historical_mom_sd, (SELECT rate FROM m WHERE signup_month='2026-04-01')-(SELECT rate FROM m WHERE signup_month='2026-03-01') march_april_delta FROM d
